command: set -e; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; "$GRADLE" :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state >/dev/null; LINE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])shizuku_server$' | head -n1 || true); echo shizuku_server_line="$LINE"; printf '%s' "$LINE" | grep -Eq '^shell[[:space:]]+'; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
